title: Political statement from Cheri Willard, candidate for Jasper Hospital District Board - NewsBreak
text:
1 days ago Cheri L Willard for Jasper Hospital District Board. With over 28 years of experience as a dedicated healthcare executive in rural areas, I am running for a position on the Jasper Hospital District Board to further enhance the quality of healthcare in our community. My career has been marked by a commitment to patient-centered care, operational excellence, and community involvement. I understand the intricacies and challenges that rural areas face in regard to quality healthcare. I would love to share and grow with each of the board members to provide quality accessible heath care to Jasper County. Read full article
